detailZones.title: Front display surface
detailZones.description: Compare the screen face with the thin outer frame and the wall panels around the display.

detailZones.title: Camera and speaker bar
detailZones.description: Locate the camera above the display and the separate video bar with two grille sections below it.

detailZones.title: Touch console
detailZones.description: Find the tilted touchscreen, its exposed wedge support and base, and the separate connected device at the back of the table.

detailZones.title: Table microphone pods
detailZones.description: Compare the four round microphones, then follow the leads from their grilles and housings to the center of the table.

detailZones.title: Cable and power hub
detailZones.description: Inspect the central outlet module and cable openings, then trace the visible adapter lead between the cabinet and the wall.

detailZones.title: Mounting and wall hardware
detailZones.description: Locate the whiteboard frame and tray, the acoustic wall panels, the glass partition and the door pull seen through it.

detailZones.title: Room furniture and finish
detailZones.description: Follow the wooden conference tabletop to its far edge, and compare the mesh chair backs with the large glass wall pane.

anchorAudit.rationale: The 1600 by 900 image shows four round microphones in two rows, a tilted touch console and an inset table outlet. Each mapped word has an image crop for its visible object or part. Related words preserve names for concealed fittings, indistinguishable device features and alternate names for the same surface.
